analysis.title: State of the Market November 2026
key_insights: High dispersion and low correlations create a compelling environment for long/short equity, per the rolling 12-month S&P 500 correlation and dispersion chart covering December 31, 1991 to September 30, 2026.

Correlation is the weighted average pair-wise correlation across index stocks over one month, and dispersion is the weighted cross-sectional standard deviation of stock performance within the index over one month. Both are shown as 12-month moving averages.
The report defines low and high relative to long-term historical averages of 0.3 for correlation and 6.9% for dispersion.
Spreads are tight for most credit asset classes as of September 30, 2026, based on option-adjusted spreads by asset class in basis points.

The credit spread chart covers corporate credit (US IG, European IG, US HY, European HY, Asia IG), securitized credit (Agency MBS, CMBS, CLO AAA/BBB/BB) and EM credit (sovereign and corporate), and shows current spreads against 10th-90th percentile historical ranges.

trade_ideas.description: Long/short equity strategies to exploit high dispersion and low correlation in S&P 500 stocks
trade_ideas.rationale: High dispersion and low correlations create a compelling environment for long/short equity.

risk_factors: Tight credit spreads across most credit asset classes as of September 30, 2026 leave less compensation for credit risk.
charts_described: Rolling 12-month S&P 500 correlation (left axis, 0.0-0.7) and dispersion (right axis, 0-15) from December 31, 1991 to September 30, 2026, with lines as 12-month moving averages.

Credit option-adjusted spread by asset class as of September 30, 2026 in basis points, with boxes showing the 25th-75th percentile range and whiskers showing the 10th-90th percentile, and a diamond marking the current spread.
vol_and_positioning: Rolling 12-month S&P 500 correlation is low and dispersion is high relative to long-term averages (0.3 correlation, 6.9% dispersion), which the report says favors long/short equity strategies.
